obernants.approximation_semantics: Source-derived relation and finite assertions; not a formal proof.
obernants.assumptions: Trusted Rust/std and successful allocations; parser/gate/decomposition dependencies.
obernants.domain: Finite CoNLL-U strings; exhaustive 3413 head vectors on 1..5 tokens with exactly one zero head and matching root/dep labels, plus explicit empty, malformed, multiword/empty-node and 64/65/66-token cases. Original word IDs are one-based; virtual graph vertex zero maps to itself.
obernants.operator: Within admitted preflight-valid vectors, exclude a passing gate with a nonzero eventual cycle, an incorrect first failure coordinate, or a parser serialization that loses retained rows. Exclude treating refreshed numeric head zero as proof that raw HEAD was valid. Assertions constrain only finite fixtures.

obernants.operator: A pass reconstructs implementations agreeing on all finite representation, error, coordinate and graph observations; it does not uniquely recover source behavior elsewhere. A gate Ok maps to many rooted trees and many preserved comments/MWT rows. A cycle-through-word-k error maps to all preflight-valid graphs whose least nonroot-basin word is k; it does not identify the actual cycle entry or edge.

obernants.operator: After root-count and raw-head preflight, tree_gate accepts iff every syntactic vertex shares cycle_id[0]. Since successor[0]=0, this cycle is exactly [0]. Exact first cycle error is min i>=1 with cycle_id[i]!=cycle_id[0]; tails into a nonroot cycle are included.

obernants.operator: Doc rejects malformed field count, nonconsecutive IDs and unknown relations before a gate call. Accepted representation can still contain malformed HEAD, range errors, relation/root mismatch, zero/multiple roots or cycles. Gate preflight scans all raw rows before cycle detection; a later malformed head therefore precedes an earlier self-loop.
